2) Can you confirm the legal entity registration number (Delaware File No.) and the company registration date? We need that for our AP ledger.

4) Remittance routing: confirm ACH details or if you prefer invoices only (we will hold POs until remittance method is confirmed).

Attached: Redwood_VendorIntake_Form_Fillable.pdf — please complete the highlighted fields (registration number, ACH details or payee bank stub, and authorized signers). If it's easier, you can reply with the fields inline.

Proposed next steps:
- You fill the intake form and send back the ACH stub (or indicate will invoice only)
- I create the vendor record and route POs to procurement@cairnworks.com as requested
- Monica will validate tax fields (cc'd) and Karthik will confirm ERP mapping for PO ingestion
